# Right <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Strings](Language-Features-Strings)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Right:String string:String, count:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text. |
| `count` | In | Int32 | required | How many characters to take. |

**Returns:** The last `count` characters.

## Description

Returns the last characters of a string. Asking for more characters than there are returns the whole string.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Right$("hello", 2)
```

```text
lo
```
